## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete publisher or visitor need and what changes for them.

## Implementation

Explain the key decisions and any changes to contracts, publication, state or shared components. Link relevant design notes when useful.

## Verification

List the meaningful checks run and their results. Distinguish local/demo, mocked-provider and explicitly authorized live testing. Include a preview for visible changes, using synthetic content.

## Limits and follow-up

Record material limitations, migration needs or remaining work. Omit this section when there is nothing relevant to report.
